project_name: Bust-up close-up anime portrait of this exact character, Pierre Mercier, 22-year-old Monégasque racing prodigy. Exact matching sleek straight blonde hair with sharp side-parting, cool piercing crystal-blue eyes, refined aristocratic jawline, calm stoic perfectionist expression, exact same bone-white and royal cobalt-blue tailored racing collar with platinum embroidery, pit radio mic clipped to collar. Thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, dynamic speed lines, cel-shaded anime style, isolated solid background
